evidence: Market news across December 7, 2018, is dominated by severe bearish momentum as Bitcoin broke down to fresh 2018 yearly lows between $3,300 and $3,400. Sentiment is heavily depressed by the SEC's formal delay of the VanEck SolidX Bitcoin ETF decision to late February 2019. Furthermore, Bitfinex reported an all-time record high in Bitcoin margin short positions exceeding 41,000 BTC, signaling heavy sell pressure and short-term targets toward $3,000. While extreme short positioning introduces potential squeeze risk, the prevailing immediate news flow reflects accelerating downward capitulation.
limitations: Relies entirely on archived crypto niche news outlets without mainstream macro coverage.
Record-high short positions present short-squeeze volatility risks counter to dominant downward momentum.
Snapshot availability and later revisions are caller-attested, not independently verified.
